pattern: QL-04 variation request from site before invoicing: provider asks for extra scope above the approved quote and waits for the answer
notes: Family 007-ioq (see research/eval-family-pc-007-ioq.md), variant v01. Mutation of event 031 (originally a one-line summary: Clarke sent the invoice and photos). Rewritten as Clarke's email from site on Wednesday 08/10/2025 at 11:42, before any invoice: spotlights done; the adjacent ceiling board is also water damaged; extra £79.35 plus VAT (£28.50 board and fixings + £50.85 for 1.5 hrs labour), which would take the job to £277.72 plus VAT against the £198.37 plus VAT the landlord approved at event 011; he can wait until 13:00 or do the quoted board only and return. Same figures as the base cut 007-invoice-40pct-over-quote, but asked for before the work instead of invoiced after it. History truncated after event 031. Attachment-02-tax-invoice.pdf removed as in the base. Expected: do not authorise the extra; ask the landlord promptly (email and ideally a call) with both figures and the reason; tell Clarke to stay within the approved scope unless the landlord agrees before he leaves, and that the second board is pending the landlord's answer. No human decision is needed: the landlord decides and the agency asks him.
